figuren.name: Sokrates Rückfrage

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

accessoires: bald ink crown with ivory side tufts
figuren.prompt_auszug: SOCRATES, MALE-READ persistent questioner. Very broad low barrel blob, bald domed crown with TWO tiny ivory clay hair tufts at sides, short split white clay chin curls framing mouth. Small faded ochre shoulder scrap. Huge unequal white eyes look at viewer, one brow high and other low, deeply inquisitive almost CLOSED crooked mouth, one large off-center upper tooth, lower lip pushed thoughtfully forward. One goo hand under OWN chin, other holds ONE plain small TERRACOTTA CUP low against belly. The cup is unlabelled, no drinking action, no death scene. Curious calm insolence rather than anger. No human nose.

figuren.name: Platon Überbau

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: PLATO, MALE-READ delighted idealist. Tall tapering pear blob with one elegantly coiled crown lobe, three SHORT ivory clay beard locks at chin edge, small muted violet shoulder fold and plain bronze clasp. White eyes gaze UP asymmetrically, one lid wide and other narrowed, eyebrows in uneven hopeful arches, shallow sideways smile with two tiny unequal teeth. Holds ONE rolled cream SCROLL at belly. Other tiny goo hand raises ONE blunt rounded finger upward beside own head, entirely inside cell. Thoughtful upward gesture, no diagram, text, extra book or human torso.

figuren.name: Aristoteles Einsort

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: ARISTOTLE, MALE-READ determined classifier. Near-square thick lobed blob with THREE low crown nubs, two short brown clay beard curls at face edge, short faded red cloth sash. Skeptical downward inspection: one white eye very round and other compressed, heavy crooked brow, CLOSED pinched lip and one small lower tooth. Holds ONE small WOOD-FRAMED WAX TABLET low across belly, one single large green LEAF specimen laid on the plain wax and steadied by a goo fingertip. Other hand touches a corner as if finding its proper category. No writing, microscope, magnifier or book pile.

figuren.name: Diogenes Unzuständig

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: DIOGENES, MALE-READ irreverent minimalist. Crooked wide bean blob with one long drooping crown lobe, two short scruffy ivory clay beard tips at mouth sides, tiny patched brown shoulder cloth, no full robe. Defiant amused disbelief: unequal huge white eyes glance SIDEWAYS, one squinting, very crooked open laugh with three widely spaced irregular teeth and enormous lower lip. Holds ONE small antique BRONZE OIL LAMP up beside own cheek, shallow rounded bowl, short spout and a tiny solid clay gold flame. Other hand hugs ONE MINIATURE CHIPPED TERRACOTTA STORAGE JAR against own belly, comically portable home. Jar does not enclose body or hide whole figure; no barrel/legs, no ground or scene.

figuren.name: Hypatia Umlauf

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: HYPATIA, FEMALE-READ absorbed mathematical/astronomical thinker. Tall soft wavy-edged pear blob, simple ivory hairband pushed back, one compact dark clay curl and subtle lashes, short muted teal shoulder fold. Intense delighted concentration: one enormous white eye focuses DOWN and opposite eye squints, raised inner brow and asymmetric small open mouth with two tiny offset teeth. Holds ONE SIMPLE handheld BRASS ARMILLARY MODEL at belly: three thick rounded intersecting rings with one central ball on a short stem gripped by goo hand. Other hand points ONE short fat wooden STYLUS at own model. Exactly three simple coherent rings, not elaborate machinery, no labels, pedestal/floor, stars or cosmic scenery.

figuren.name: Epikura Genug

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug:
EPICUREAN / EPICURUS-INSPIRED FEMALE-READ SLOP, contentment in modest things. Round compact soft dumpling splat with two little curled crown lobes, subtle lashes and a tiny olive-leaf pin at side, small cream shoulder fold, no crown or long hair. Profound unhurried satisfaction, gently unequal half-lidded WHITE/red/black eyes looking toward viewer, relaxed asymmetric CLOSED smile with one tiny ivory lower tooth. One hand cradles ONE small rustic plain BREAD ROLL with a single bite removed; other holds ONE little unadorned cream WATER CUP. Simple bread and water, not a banquet, coins, wine or luxury. Body comfortable and bouncy but fully upright and footless.

Layout: six LARGE complete self-contained silhouettes in regular3x2 grid, similar substantial BODY HEIGHT across both rows. Full actors450-475px tall in512pxlogical cells, safe margins/gutters and at least24-32px transparent gap between rows. Keep every tuft, finger, scroll, leaf, cup, lamp, jar, model, bread and droplet within OWN cell; no touching/overlap/props across seams, clipped silhouettes or miniature bottom row. Face/goo dominates, accessories sparing and bold enough for gameplay. No gridlines, background, floor, shadow disc, gradient, checkerboard, halo, floating symbols, text or watermark. Real alpha-zero transparency outside characters, opaque interiors, clean antialiased edges; soft upper-left studio lighting only on figures.
